NUMNAME-NN-C54.say: This name number is linked with honour, good speaking, wealth and scholarship. There is also a possible weakness in the legs, so take good care of your health.

NUMNAME-NN-C55.say: This name number makes you a leader of others, sharp-witted, religious and generous.

NUMNAME-NN-C56.say: This name number is both lucky and unlucky: you are usually fortunate and like to lead, but can feel uneasy or panicky, so practise self-control.

NUMNAME-NN-C57.say: This name number is linked with success in work and trade, and a cheerful, active nature.

NUMNAME-NN-C58.say: This name number can make you a good doctor, with an open and affectionate nature.

NUMNAME-NN-C59.say: This name number is linked with freedom from fear, many trades, much travel and victory, with sea voyages, banking or brokerage proving fruitful. Avoid speculation and keep your dealings honest.

NUMNAME-NN-C60.say: This name number gives you a happy nature and can bring success as a doctor, compounder or nurse.

NUMNAME-NN-C61.say: This name number gives you a love of travel and a peaceful, self-controlled nature.

NUMNAME-NN-C62.say: This name number can help you do well in detective work or as a commander in the armed forces, and is linked with prosperity.

NUMNAME-NN-C63.say: This name number makes you healthy, generous and glad at others' progress, and successful in business, though you tend to spend freely.

NUMNAME-NN-C64.say: This name number suits a job rather than business, such as doctor or advocate, along with literary interests. You may resist ties like marriage.

NUMNAME-NN-C65.say: This name number brings the patronage of powerful people and a happy married life. There is some risk of accident or injury, so stay careful.

NUMNAME-NN-C66.say: This name number is linked with success in work and trade, and a cheerful, active nature.

NUMNAME-NN-C67.say: This name number can make you a good doctor, with an open and affectionate nature.

NUMNAME-NN-C68.say: This name number is linked with freedom from fear, many trades, much travel and victory, with sea voyages, banking or brokerage proving fruitful. Avoid speculation and keep your dealings honest.

NUMNAME-NN-C69.say: This name number is linked with prestige, honour, luck and fame.

NUMNAME-NN-C70.say: This name number is linked with good luck, though not very strong.
